patch_description:
I redesigned the ansatz into a compact symmetric mixer-entangler-mixer block.  
The new block removes the extra RX layer, keeps only the rotations that matter most for Z-readout, and adds sparse next-nearest-neighbor CRZ bridges on top of the CZ chain.  
This lowers the parameter count and gate count versus the current program while preserving enough entanglement to model higher-order feature interactions and improve generalization.
